caption: The video captures a wide, saturated sunset sky glowing orange-red above a dark silhouetted ridgeline. A thin, curved rainbow-like arc descends along the left edge, holding steady against the frame. Violet-blue tones linger in the upper left while soft crepuscular-style beams radiate through the clouds. A low horizontal cloud band rests just above the hills. Thin wispy clouds drift and reshape very slowly across the upper and central sky. The bright orange core near the center shifts subtly in intensity, its luminous region broadening and leaning gradually toward the right. The silhouetted hills remain fixed in position and shape throughout, anchoring the scene as the light and cloud forms continue their slow, ongoing transformation.
